## 1 UNDERSTAND
Validate input, extract profile via LLM,
parse/repair JSON, normalise roles

## 2 RETRIEVE
Build query text, embed via Gemini,
hybrid search in Supabase (FTS + vector, RRF)

## 3 RANK
Re-rank by role fit, interest, availability.
MMR diversify across challenges.

## 4 EXPLAIN
LLM writes friendly 25-word reasons.
Attach to cards, fallback template if LLM fails.
